title: Original Copper (MC Live 2020)
description: Trial Chambers now have a more vibrant look with original copper colors!
body:
Hawwo!

Trial Chambers now have a more vibrant look with original copper colors!

This pack changes the color of all the copper-related blocks to fit with the copper texture shown on MC Live 2020.

Featuring:
- Copper blocks.
- Cut copper (slabs and stairs).
- Copper ore (stone and deepslate).
- Raw copper (block and item).
- Copper ingot.
- Chiseled copper.
- Copper grate.
- Copper bulb.
- Copper doors.
- Copper trapdoors.
- Lightning rod.
- Brush.
- Trial key.
- Ominous Trial key.
- The 3 new music discs.
- Bold armor trim template.
- Trident.

Also changes the main menu panorama to show the colors of the resource pack.

This pack is for Java edition (No need to unzip).

Hope you like it! (:

I´m listening to any feedback and suggestions for new resource packs. (You can reach me at Planet Minecraft: [valesde_valley](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/valesde_valley/)) 

Credits to Jappa for the copper texture shown on MC Live 2020.
